notes.title: List of bug fixes
notes.content:
Version 1.01
Bug: When Poco is unarmed.
When she takes down the enemy, he comes alive like zombies.
Solution: Removed the Take-Down. (when she is unarmed.)

Version 1.02
Fixed the phenomenon that the animation becomes strange when the player enters the water after flying while armed.

Version 1.03
Made minor corrections.

Version 1.04 
Dealt with a phenomenon in which the motion becomes strange when entering flight mode while aiming. The music on the loading screen is too noisy, so we deleted it.

Version 1.05
After removing the take-down(unarmed), we dealt with the problem that the enemy becomes a zombie in the armed take-down.
Supported Traditional Chinese.

To play a previous versions
Right-click the game name in the STEAM Library.
